about: Part 4 tool table, written from the copied τ-bench tool code only (from_shieldagent/tau_bench/tau_bench/envs/<domain>/tools/*.py). Notes: output/p4_tool_notes.md. Used by state_tracker/state.py.

fields.kinds: object kinds of the shown set and of db(): where the database copy keeps them, and their id
fields.kinds.<kind>.table: the top-level key of the τ-bench data dict; the dict key is the object's id
fields.kinds.<kind>.id_field: the field inside the object that holds the id, or null if the object has no id field (then the id is only the dict key)
fields.kinds.<kind>.nested_in: for a nested kind: [parent kind, field of the parent that maps id -> nested object]. The nested object is given as a copy with the parent's id added under parent_id_as
fields.kinds.<kind>.from_tool: for a kind that is not in the data files: the read tool whose constant output defines it
fields.tools.<tool>.changes_db: true if a successful call can change the database
fields.tools.<tool>.changes: what a successful call changes (from the code)
fields.tools.<tool>.output: format of a successful output: object | flight_list | flight_pair_list | name_to_id | code_to_city | text
fields.tools.<tool>.kind: kind of the object(s) in the output (null for text)
fields.tools.<tool>.id_from: where the object's id comes from: field:<name> (inside the output) or arg:<name> (the call's argument)
fields.tools.<tool>.errors: failed outputs start with 'Error'; τ-bench's env turns any exception into 'Error: <exception>'

product_type.note: {name, product_id}; the fact version is built from the products table

calculate.note: the result as text, rounded to 2 decimals

cancel_pending_order.changes: order: status -> 'cancelled', cancel_reason, refund entries added to payment_history; user: a gift card used to pay gets the refund added to its balance

exchange_delivered_order_items.changes: order: status -> 'exchange requested', exchange_items, exchange_new_items, exchange_payment_method_id, exchange_price_difference (no payment is made yet)

find_user_id_by_email.note: the user id as plain text; kept in the event log only

find_user_id_by_name_zip.note: the user id as plain text; kept in the event log only

get_product_details.note: also adds each variant (kind variant) to the shown set

get_user_details.note: the user object has no id field; also adds each payment method (kind payment_method)

list_all_product_types.note: {product name: product id} for all 50 products

modify_pending_order_items.changes: order: items (item_id, price, options), a payment or refund entry in payment_history, status -> 'pending (item modified)'; user: gift card balance if a gift card pays or gets the difference

modify_pending_order_payment.changes: order: a new payment and a refund in payment_history; user: gift card balances of the new and the old method

modify_user_address.changes: user: address (the default address; orders keep their own address)

return_delivered_order_items.changes: order: status -> 'return requested', return_items, return_payment_method_id (no refund is made yet)

transfer_to_human_agents.note: always 'Transfer successful'; τ-bench ends the conversation after it (terminate_tools)

flight.note: a flight with dates {date: {status, ...}}. The shown version has the same shape, with only the dates that were shown

airport.note: {code, city}; not in the data files: the 20 airports are constants in the tool code

book_reservation.changes: new reservation (id HATHAT, then HATHAU, HATHAV; created_at 2024-05-15T15:00:00); user: reservation id added, gift card amount reduced, a used certificate removed. Flight seats are not changed

calculate.note: the result as text, rounded to 2 decimals

cancel_reservation.changes: reservation: status -> 'cancelled', a negative entry per payment added to payment_history. No balance is changed and the status is not checked first

get_reservation_details.note: an unknown reservation gives 'Error: user not found' (sic)

get_user_details.note: the user object has no id field; also adds each payment method (kind payment_method)

list_all_airports.note: a fixed list of 20 airports, not from the database

search_direct_flight.note: a list of flights that are 'available' on the date; each is the flight without 'dates', plus that date's status, available_seats and prices. The date is the call's argument 'date'

search_onestop_flight.note: a list of [first leg, second leg]; each leg has a 'date' field. τ-bench quirk: the second leg's status, seats and prices are taken from the first leg's date, even when its own date is the next day

send_certificate.changes: user: a certificate payment method (certificate_3221322, then ...23, ...24) with the amount
send_certificate.note: output 'Certificate <id> added to user <user> with amount <n>.'; kept in the event log only. Returns None (no text) if all 3 ids are taken

transfer_to_human_agents.note: always 'Transfer successful'; τ-bench ends the conversation after it (terminate_tools)

update_reservation_baggages.changes: reservation: total_baggages, nonfree_baggages, a payment entry if extra bags cost money; user: gift card amount reduced

update_reservation_flights.changes: reservation: flights (all segments, with prices), a payment entry for the price difference; user: gift card amount reduced. The cabin field and flight seats are not changed
